set (prj_LIB_INCLUDE_DIRS
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/jaulib/include
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
)

include_directories(
  ${prj_LIB_INCLUDE_DIRS}
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
  ${SYS_INCLUDE_DIRS}
)

set (prj_COMMON_LIB_SRCS
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/jaulib/src/basic_types.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/jaulib/src/base_codec.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/jaulib/src/debug.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/jaulib/src/environment.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/jaulib/src/file_util.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/cgit.cpp
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/cgit-reaper.cpp
# autogenerated files
  ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/Version.cpp
)

add_executable(cgit-reaper ${prj_COMMON_LIB_SRCS})
target_compile_options(cgit-reaper PUBLIC ${prj_CXX_FLAGS})
target_link_options(cgit-reaper PUBLIC ${prj_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS})

if( (USE_STRIP) AND (NOT EMSCRIPTEN) )
add_custom_command(TARGET cgit-reaper POST_BUILD
                   COMMAND ${STRIP} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cgit-reaper
                   COMMENT "stripping executable"
                   VERBATIM
                   )
endif()

install(TARGETS cgit-reaper RUNTIME DESTINATION ${CMAKE_INSTALL_BINDIR})
